Returned 6 ranked results. Key fact-check signals for the parent agent:

- **Confirmed (primary source):** Ghostty supports the Kitty Graphics Protocol and has explicitly declined Sixel — per official GitHub Discussion #2496.
- **Uncertain / conflicting:** One secondary blog claims "Ghostty 1.4.0 supports sixel rendering," which contradicts the official maintainer stance. This needs verification against ghostty.org release notes before being treated as true.
- **Protocol comparison (well-sourced):** Sixel is palette-based (0-100 color range vs 0-255), slower, lower quality; Kitty supports PNG/animated GIF/GPU-accel; iTerm2 OSC 1337 uses direct base64.
- **Tool dependency mapping:** Compatibility matrix confirms WezTerm supports all three, Kitty/Ghostty back Kitty protocol, Alacritty supports none — relevant to whether kitten icat/chafa/timg/viu work under Ghostty.
